name: @w6w-apps/plaud
description: Plaud Dev API: register devices, upload audio to Plaud storage and transcribe it with Plaud's speech models.

w6w.longDescription:
Plaud makes AI voice recorders, and its Dev API (Plaud Embedded) lets a company build the recording and transcription into its own product. This app covers the parts of that API a workflow can call from a server: the cloud device registry (bind, unbind, read a device's binding state), audio upload to Plaud storage, and asynchronous transcription with language, speaker and custom-vocabulary options.

It is built for pipelines that turn conversation audio into text: upload or point at a recording, submit it, poll until it is done, and hand the transcript and its time-aligned segments to the next step. It authenticates as a Plaud partner application (client id and secret key from the Plaud developer portal) acting as one end user, and the app mints and renews the 24-hour user token itself. Transcription needs the application's separate API key.

It does not record, pair, or read recordings from a personal Plaud account. The Bluetooth half of binding and the recording itself belong to Plaud's mobile Embedded SDK, and a personal account's recordings are reachable only through Plaud's MCP and CLI, which sign in as a person.
